lines.text: The commander released Paul, brought him before the whole Sanhedrin, and Paul said he had lived before God in all good conscience.
The high priest Ananias ordered Paul struck on the mouth, and Paul called him a whitewashed wall.
Paul said he was not aware Ananias was the centurion, and he quoted Scripture against speaking evil about a ruler of the people.
Paul said he was on trial for his hope in the resurrection, and the Pharisees and Sadducees began to dispute.
The commander had soldiers take Paul into the temple, and that night the Lord told him to take courage.
